topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I just got back from a lovely walk around the neighborhood when I noticed a parcel on my doorstep. Curious, I picked it up, admiring the neat handwriting on the address label. Opening it, I found a beautiful, handcrafted vase inside, wrapped with care. It struck me as a charming piece, and I couldn’t help but imagine it on my living room mantel. Then, it dawned on me—the label had the previous tenant’s name. Well, what a delightful surprise! I decided to enjoy it for a few days, imagining the story behind it, before I tracked down the rightful owner to pass it along with a little note. Life’s little surprises are the best, aren’t they?
